name: K-UX-AI

home.title: K-UX-AI
home.subtitle: Understand the work, build the interface.
home.intro: The operator and the system share this workspace. You use it to understand the work, guide the AI and act; the system uses it to show information, changes and proposals.
home.method: Both can take part at the same time, working on the same subject. K-UX-AI gives the AI the knowledge and method to shape text, images, motion and tools for that exchange, and to learn through use.
home.use: Here you can discover K-UX-AI and try different ways of working. Choose a topic and open the workspace: arrange cards side by side, bring one into focus and resume a draft.
home.scope: The cards use examples of the K-UX-AI service. Send lets you ask MAIOS AI a question on a configured site; contributions and drafts in other cards stay in this session.

presentationTitle: Work takes shape through the interface.
presentationMeaning: K-UX-AI forms a shared interface for operator actions and system communication. You can guide, act and correct while the system makes information, changes and proposals visible in the same work context. The project provides its documents, tools and authorised actions.
exploreTitle: One medium, several ways to take part.
exploreMeaning: Guidance, tools, action and resumption keep the work recognisable as the arrangement of cards changes.

phases.title: Understand
phases.text: Intent, people, the subject and sources establish what needs to become perceivable and usable.

phases.title: Compose
phases.text: The competence selects and builds the relevant forms and means: text, space, movement, tools and ways to act.

phases.title: Use
phases.text: Human actions and system communication can take place at the same time, preserving the subject, focus and contribution as the workspace changes.

phases.title: Learn
phases.text: A consequence reveals what needs improvement. Knowledge changes in the competence that must build or operate differently next time.

defaults.object: The medium that makes work understandable and usable
defaults.method: Form follows the current work. Code preserves input, focus and references; a consequence can improve the method and construction.
defaults.checkTitle: Does the interface make the work clear?
defaults.checkMeaning: Local observations help examine the relationship between work, its form and the person’s action.
defaults.designTitle: Two ways to make work perceivable.
defaults.communicateTitle: Make the point of continuation clear.
defaults.communicationMeaning: Describing the gesture, subject and consequence lets another person or AI resume the work.
defaults.reentryMeaning: Continuity retains reasons, contributions and references. The workspace retrieves contributions from this session; in the working kernel, knowledge continues through its competences.
defaults.experimentTitle: What form does this situation need?
defaults.experimentMeaning: Explore different arrangements and ways of working while preserving the same subject.
defaults.monitorTitle: Observe what changes in the workspace.
defaults.monitorMeaning: A new event can make a source or activity relevant. Here you can observe that relationship through an illustrative case.
defaults.monitorHorizon: An adopting environment can connect its own sources and tools. The medium preserves the reference as what matters changes.
defaults.compareTitle: Two contributions about the same medium.
compareTexts: Preserve subject, focus and draft while changing views
Preserve subject and draft, bring a new relationship into focus
defaults.aiMeaning: The guide answers questions about K-UX-AI, the current topic and how to use the cards.
defaults.aiPrompt: How can this card help me understand K-UX-AI?

horizon.title: New surfaces, the same interaction
horizon.body: With glasses that display interactive video in real time, information, diagrams and tools could accompany what a person sees and does. The visual experience could change with their gaze, voice or gestures, making useful details, relationships and changes easier to perceive during work. This is a development direction for the medium.
horizon.current_demo: The current demo uses cards, tools and dialogue.
